title: The Morning Build
summary: Nine stories from 31 sources · about 14 minutes

lead.title: Deterministic replays are back in fashion for puzzle games
lead.dek: Recording inputs instead of state turns a bug report into something you can run. Three teams describe what it cost them and what they stopped doing afterwards.
lead.body:
The idea is old, the reason it returned is new: with input logs small enough to attach to every crash, the question changes from "can you reproduce it" to "which frame".

Two of the three teams now refuse a bug report without one.
